observation.command:
cd /workspace
echo "=== Confirm the 5 down backend services: all are uvicorn (long-running) servers that should NOT be 'Completed' ==="
for s in comment fpp gesetzesbegruendung-db jura-db plausibility-notes; do
  curl -s http://localhost:8080/process/info/$s | /workspace/.venv/bin/python -c "
import json,sys
d=json.load(sys.stdin)
c=d.get('command','')
kind='uvicorn-server' if 'uvicorn' in c else 'other'
print(f\"{d['name']:26s} {kind:16s} port={__import__('re').search(r'port (\d+)',c).group(1)} restart={d.get('restarts')}\")
"
done
echo
echo "=== The 3 legitimate seeds (one-shot, expected to Complete) ==="
for s in project-logic-seed formal-completeness-seed administrative-file-draft-seed; do
  curl -s http://localhost:8080/process/info/$s | /workspace/.venv/bin/python -c "
import json,sys
d=json.load(sys.stdin); c=d.get('command','')
kind='seed-job' if 'seed' in c else 'other'
print(f\"{d['name']:34s} {kind}\")
"
done
echo
echo "=== Timeline: all 5 services exited within ~7s at 00:43 (memory pressure window) ==="
grep -E "Exited.*process=(jura-db|gesetzesbegruendung-db|plausibility-notes|comment|fpp)" /tmp/process-compose-root.log
